# dsFlowerClient

Researcher-side orchestration for Flower federated learning through DataSHIELD.
Privacy is server-authoritative: the client cannot configure epsilon, delta,
clipping, lifetime accounting domains, or HookApp execution policy.

Current documentation:

- Home and security overview: https://isglobal-brge.github.io/dsFlowerClient/
- API quickstart: https://isglobal-brge.github.io/dsFlowerClient/articles/api-quickstart.html
- Server method registration: https://isglobal-brge.github.io/dsFlowerClient/articles/method-registration-live-federation.html
- Function reference: https://isglobal-brge.github.io/dsFlowerClient/reference/

The current contract uses a persistent geometric lifetime accountant,
release-scoped secret-keyed CSPRNG streams, declarative DP-SGD/DP-GBDT, public
feature bounds, and a fail-closed HookApp sandbox gate. Exact node feature
statistics, logs, metrics and cohort weights are disabled. Historical benchmark
articles marked pre-0.3 are evidence for a retired architecture and are not
current deployment or security instructions.
